dex.text: Hops onto the garden table and demands crumbs with the confidence of a landlord. Its waistcoat is only red when it is feeling important.
dex.fact: European robins sing through autumn and winter as well as in spring, so they are never entirely off duty.

dex.text: Claims the whole garden, the shed and the bit of hedge behind the shed, and will defend all of it from the top of the fence. Politely. Mostly.
dex.fact: Robins defend their territory all year round, which is why one may sing at you from a fence post while you dig the veg patch.
